column1: 20583§traverse§trəˈvɜːs§Other items could have been used by hunters traversing the high mountain passes of Oppland: all-purpose items like tools, skis, and horse tack.§**穿越**奥普兰高山隘口的猎人还可能使用其他物品：工具、滑雪板和马具等通用物品。§
20584§positive§ˈpɒzətɪv§Customer comments, both positive and negative, are recorded by staff.§对于顾客的意见，无论是**肯定的**还是否定的，都由职员予以记录。§
20585§assistant§əˈsɪstənt§The employees felt that their assistant manager was closer to them than the manager.§和经理相比，员工们感觉**助理**经理与他们更亲近。§
20586§obligation§ˌɒblɪˈɡeɪʃn§Every government has the right and obligation to run its own internal affairs well.§每一任政府都有管理好国家内政的权利和**职责**。§
20587§liberty§ˈlɪbəti§You have liberty to use all the library facilities.§你们可以**随意**使用图书馆里的所有设施。§
20588§pesticide§ˈpestɪsaɪd§The main factors that could be contributing to the decline of the species include acid rain and the spread of the pesticide residues.§导致这个物种灭绝的主要因素包括酸雨和**农药**残留物的扩散。§
20589§poll§pəʊl§The team is conducting a poll among freshmen.§这个小组正在新生中进行一次**民意调查**。§
20590§refundable§rɪˈfʌndəbl§The deposit on the house is refundable.§这个房子的押金是**可以退还的**。§
20591§homesick§ˈhəʊmsɪk§I was homesick at first and missed my family.§起初，我**思乡**心切，想念我的家人。§
20592§compassionate§kəmˈpæʃənət§We should try our best to create a more compassionate society.§我们应该竭尽全力营造一个更**富有同情心**的社会。§改译文：「人性化」不是 compassionate 的意思，改为「富有同情心」

20593§orientate§ˈɔːriənteɪt§The course at this university has a vocational focus on preparing its graduates for work, so students are orientated towards employment.§这所大学的课程以职业为中心，注重毕业生工作之前的准备工作，因此将学生**朝着**就业方向培养。§改例句：orientated at 介词误用，改为 orientated towards
20594§insight§ˈɪnsaɪt§The application of our new insights into the Amazonian past would change present policies on development in the region.§我们对亚马孙地区的过去有了新的**了解**，这会改变目前我们针对这一地区的开发政策。§
20595§resist§rɪˈzɪst§Bugs and weeds will begin to resist poisons.§害虫和野草会开始产生**抗**药性。§
20596§glide§glaɪd§The pilot managed to glide down to a safe landing.§飞行员成功地使飞机向下**滑行**并安全着陆。§
20597§casualty§ˈkæʒuəlti§The major casualty of cutting down forests on a large scale has been the environment.§大规模森林砍伐的最大**受害者**是环境。§改译文：原译「影响最大的」没译出 casualty，改为「最大受害者」
20598§belief§bɪˈliːf§The belief that rain and murky weather make people more unhappy is borne out by a study in Belgium.§人们**相信**雨天和阴沉的天气会让人更加忧郁，这种想法已被比利时的一项研究所证实。§
20599§concentration§ˌkɒnsnˈtreɪʃn§This concentration of vehicles makes air quality in urban areas unpleasant and sometimes dangerous to breathe.§交通工具的**集中**造成城市地区空气质量的恶劣，有时甚至不宜呼吸。§
20600§tug§tʌg§The fisherman tugged the small boat out of the water.§渔民用力把小船**拖**到岸上。§
20601§proceed§prəˈsiːd§Our work is proceeding slowly.§我们的工作**进程**缓慢。§
20602§status§ˈsteɪtəs§The chart shows the amount of leisure time enjoyed by men and women of different employment status.§这张图表显示了不同职业**身份**的男性和女性享有多少闲暇时间。§

20603§document§ˈdɒkjumənt§In the English-speaking scientific world, surveys of books and documents consulted in libraries and other information agencies have shown that very little foreign-language material is ever consulted.§在以讲英语为主的科学界里，调查显示，科学家们几乎不参考图书馆及其他信息机构中的非英语书籍和**文献**。§
20604§hostile§ˈhɒstaɪl§The luxuriant forests of Amazonia seem ageless, unconquerable, a habitat totally hostile to human civilization.§茂密的亚马孙丛林似乎是永恒的、无法征服的，是一个完全**不利于**人类文明存在的地方。§
20605§intervene§ˌɪntəˈviːn§The bank intervened with a large dollar purchase.§那家银行以大量购进美元的方式来进行**干预**。§
20606§promote§prəˈməʊt§The band has gone on tour to promote their new album.§这个乐队已开始巡回**宣传**他们的新唱片。§
20607§bump§bʌmp§The policeman ran after the thief, bumping against people in his hurry.§那个警察追赶小偷，匆忙中**撞到**了人。§
20608§reunion§ˌriːˈjuːniən§All the members of the club gathered to have a reunion dinner last weekend.§上周末，这个俱乐部的所有成员进行了一次**聚**餐。§
20609§digestive§daɪˈdʒestɪv§The professor introduced the feeding habits and digestive systems of starfish.§教授介绍了海星摄取食物的习惯以及它们的**消化**系统。§改例句：Professor 前缺冠词，补 The
20610§homestay§ˈhəʊmsteɪ§A: I've heard that you want to move into a homestay family. Is that correct? B: Yes, that's right.§A: 我听说你想搬入一个**寄宿**家庭，是吗？B: 是的。§
20611§commit§kəˈmɪt§The drivers refused to commit themselves to the traffic accident.§司机们拒绝**承担**这起交通事故的责任。§
20612§practically§ˈpræktɪkli§There is evidence that the reaction principle was applied practically well before the rocket was invented.§有证据证明，反作用原理在火箭发明前就得到了很好的**实际**应用。§
20613§acrobat§ˈækrəbæt§They are acrobats with the Albanian State Circus.§他们是阿尔巴尼亚国家马戏团的**杂技演员**。§
20614§revenue§ˈrevənjuː§A new strategy for pricing known as "revenue management" is now being used by many large companies.§现在许多大公司都采用一项名为“**收入**管理”的新定价策略。§改例句：英文句中的中文引号改为英文引号
20615§nickel§ˈnɪkl§Nickel can be used to make batteries.§**镍**可以用来制造电池。§
20616§limp§lɪmp§Some of you may come from cultures that accept limp handshakes as normal.§你们当中有些人的文化习俗可能认为**无力的**握手很正常。§
20617§spit§spɪt§Don't spit at random.§不要随地**吐痰**。§

20618§irregularity§ɪˌregjəˈlærəti§To date, the most widely used commercial biometric system is the handkey, a type of hand scanner which reads the unique shape, size and irregularities of people's hands.§迄今为止，在商业生物测定系统中应用最广泛的是掌形识别仪，这是一种读取人们手掌独有的形状、大小和**不规则性**的手掌扫描仪。§
20619§breeze§briːz§The systems mix light, sounds, breezes and scents to stimulate people who spend long periods below ground.§该系统综合了光线、声音、**微风**和香味来刺激长期待在地下的人。§
20620§avenue§ˈævənjuː§They explored every avenue to cure cancer.§他们寻找各种**方法**来治疗癌症。§
20621§magnify§ˈmægnɪfaɪ§This microscope can magnify an object 100,000 times.§这个显微镜可将物体**放大**10万倍。§
20622§hive§haɪv§For the three-week long bloom, beekeepers can hire out their hives for $32 each.§在长达三周的花期里，养蜂人可以将他们的**蜂箱**以每个32美元的价格租出去。§

20623§oxide§ˈɒksaɪd§The greenhouse effect is a natural phenomenon due to the presence of greenhouse gases—water vapour, carbon dioxide and nitrous oxide—in the atmosphere.§温室效应是一种由大气中的水蒸气、二氧化碳和一**氧化**二氮这些温室气体形成的自然现象。§改译文：nitrous oxide 是一氧化二氮，原译“一氧化氮”有误
20624§foremost§ˈfɔːməʊst§First and foremost, I suppose, is the popularity of the event in global terms.§我认为，首先也是**最重要的**，是这个活动在全球范围内的受欢迎程度。§
20625§procedure§prəˈsiːdʒə(r)§I hate these cumbersome administrative procedures.§我讨厌这些麻烦的行政**手续**。§
20626§assemble§əˈsembl§All components were assembled in the front workshop.§所有部件都是在前面的车间**组装**的。§
20627§plagiarism§ˈpleɪdʒərɪzəm§I'd like to mention the question of plagiarism in particular.§我想特别提一下**剽窃**问题。§
20628§gallop§ˈgæləp§My sister set off at a gallop this morning.§今天早上我姐姐**匆忙**出发。§
20629§pledge§pledʒ§The prime minister has pledged today that he will make 250 million dollars available to help the drought-stricken farmers.§总理今天**承诺**将拨2.5亿美元帮助受旱灾影响的农民。§
20630§effective§ɪˈfektɪv§Which advertisement is the most effective?§哪一种广告最**有效**？§
20631§appreciate§əˈpriːʃieɪt§I deeply appreciate your care, but I'm fine now.§我对你的关心深表**感激**，但是现在我很好。§
20632§deny§dɪˈnaɪ§If you don't acknowledge the source of your information, you might be denied entry into the university.§如果你不供认信息的来源，你可能会被这所大学**拒**收。§
20633§union§ˈjuːniən§The speech contest is presided over by the Student Union.§这个演讲比赛是由学生**会**主办的。§改例句：preside 作及物用法须加 over，补 over
20634§responsibility§rɪˌspɒnsəˈbɪləti§The company needs a sales manager with responsibility for the North American market.§该公司需要一位**负责**北美市场的销售经理。§改例句：North American market 前缺冠词，补 the
20635§conform§kənˈfɔːm§All students must conform to the school rules.§所有的学生都必须**遵守**校规。§
20636§handy§ˈhændi§To do this work needs handy men.§做这项工作需要些**手巧的**人。§
20637§notify§ˈnəʊtɪfaɪ§If the library is not notified and you are 15 minutes late, your time can be given to someone else.§如果你没有**通知**图书馆，那么在你迟到15分钟后，你（预约）的时间就会分配给其他人。§
20638§splendid§ˈsplendɪd§She married that rich man not merely because he is rich and has splendid houses.§她嫁给那个富人，并不仅仅是因为他有钱和**豪华的**房子。§
20639§direction§dəˈrekʃn§Shall we ask somebody for directions again?§我们还要再找人问一下**路**吗？§
20640§execute§ˈeksɪkjuːt§We execute company policy for homeowners.§我们**执行**公司针对业主的政策。§
20641§witness§ˈwɪtnəs§Tom witnessed the accident.§汤姆**目睹**了那起意外事故。§
20642§elbow§ˈelbəʊ§His forearms were black and blue from wrist to elbow.§他的小臂从手腕到**肘部**又青又紫。§
20643§limited§ˈlɪmɪtɪd§Some banks open for a limited time on Saturdays.§一些银行在周六**限**时开放。§
20644§vessel§ˈvesl§Sea ports have been transformed by the advent of powered vessels.§机动**船只**的出现改变了海港的外观。§
20645§private§ˈpraɪvət§May I ask you a private question?§我能问你一个**私人**问题吗？§
20646§stereo§ˈsteriəʊ§I've got a fridge and a stereo system which I've just bought from a friend.§我刚从一个朋友那里买了一台冰箱和一套**立体声**音响。§
20647§soak§səʊk§We'll get you up to your room and soak your feet, and then you'll be okay.§我们带你到房间里**泡泡**脚，这样你会感觉舒服些。§
20648§stout§staʊt§This machine was completely encased in a stout, iron cylinder.§这台机器被完全置于一个**结实的**铁筒内。§
20649§greasy§ˈɡriːsi§Fish contains a lot of protein, and is not greasy.§鱼肉富含蛋白质且不**油腻**。§改译文：「脂肪含量低」没译出 greasy，改为「不油腻」
20650§boast§bəʊst§She is always boasting about how wonderful her children are.§她总是**夸耀**她的孩子们多么出色。§
20651§swift§swɪft§Beijing has cheap, swift and effective public transport.§北京的公共交通便宜、**快捷**且高效。§
